description: Hochwasser-Gefahrenzonenplan Wien is a dataset listed in opendataportal.at, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by data.wien.gv.at. Overview of flood risk areas for flood events that occur statistically once in a hundred years. The designations are based on precipitation and discharge studies for the respective catchment area of the river. The flood-prone areas are divided into different zones in accordance with the technical guidelines for the Federal Water Engineering Administration (Bundeswasserbauverwaltung BWV). Coverage: AT. The portal shows the English title as "Flood hazard zone plan Vienna" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Abflussuntersuchung, Gefahrenzonenplanung, ViennaGIS, Überflutungsflächen, Gefahrenzonenausweisung, Hochwasser. The listing shows 6 download or service links in JPEG, GML, GIF. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/deed.de). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-open-data-portal-austria.
